title: send aftercare reminder notifications
description: Test the /aftercare-reminder POST endpoint to verify that it correctly finds completed appointments from 24 hours ago and sends category-specific aftercare push notifications to clients. Validate the response includes a success message and the list of appointment IDs processed.

title: send appointment reminder notifications
description: Test the /appointment-reminders POST endpoint to ensure it finds confirmed appointments and sends push notifications at 24 hours and 1 hour before the appointment. Verify the response indicates success and includes the reminders sent.

title: create stripe payment intent
description: Test the /create-payment-intent POST endpoint to create a Stripe PaymentIntent for pre-authorization during booking. Validate required fields such as amount and appointment_id are enforced and the response returns clientSecret and paymentIntentId on success.

title: capture stripe payment
description: Test the /capture-payment POST endpoint to capture a previously authorized Stripe PaymentIntent. Verify that providing a valid payment_intent_id captures the payment and returns success status.

title: cancel stripe payment hold
description: Test the /cancel-payment POST endpoint to cancel a Stripe PaymentIntent hold and release funds. Confirm that the endpoint requires payment_intent_id and returns success status upon cancellation.

title: send low stock alert notifications
description: Test the /low-stock-alert POST endpoint to check for products with stock below threshold and send push notifications to admin and owner users. Validate the response includes a message and list of low stock products.

title: send marketing push notifications
description: Test the /send-marketing-notification POST endpoint to send promotional push notifications to users with optional role filtering. Verify that only owners/admins can access this endpoint and that missing required fields return appropriate errors.

title: send message notification on new chat message
description: Test the /send-message-notification POST endpoint to send push notifications when a new chat message is received. Validate support for both message_id and record payloads, and verify error handling for missing or invalid data.
